mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (user_id, post_id, content, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{postId}, #{content}, now())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM comment WHERE id = #{id} AND delete_at IS NULL

SELECT c.id AS commentId, c.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS writerNickname, c.content AS content, c.created_at AS createdAt, COALESCE(lc.like_count, 0) AS likeCount, CASE WHEN l.id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS isLiked FROM comment c JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN like_count lc ON lc.comment_id = c.id LEFT JOIN likes l ON l.comment_id = c.id AND l.user_id = #{currentUserId} WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.delete_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at ASC
